purpose: Exploration-time rules for evidence-grounded ecommerce image suites.

global_rules.visual_text_policy: Prefer no generated text. Add approved English copy, measurements, arrows, and labels deterministically after generation.
global_rules.reference_identity: Use approved reference images to preserve the product's shape, color, print, material appearance, component arrangement, and proportions.
global_rules.facts: Only state claims supported by source text, source images, or explicit human review. Keep inferred visual observations separate from verified facts.
prohibited: Chinese or other non-English visible text
invented logos, brands, certifications, performance claims, or components
watermarks, unreadable text, packaging art, and unrelated products
global_rules.review: Approve the identity references, fact card, category rules, and full image recipe before funding one complete generation batch. Generated images remain subject to per-image human review.

profiles.description: Artificial seasonal wreaths and door/wall hanging decorations.
planning_rules: Use one approved hero reference as the sole product-identity source for generated images.
Treat component or dimension sheets as evidence only unless a human explicitly approves them as visual references.
Show realistic door, porch, or indoor mantel placement without obstructing the wreath.

profiles.description: Flat wall decals, edge decals, and self-adhesive decorative stickers.
planning_rules: Preserve flat decal geometry; do not turn a wall decal into a framed object, sculpture, or unrelated decor product.
Only depict peeling, adhesive layers, waterproofing, or removability when those claims are source-supported.
Show the product on a plausible approved wall or furniture surface, not a random door frame unless the product is actually a door decal.

By default, do not generate white-background hero, size-card, or macro-detail images for wall decals. The human operator may explicitly add a size card only after rejecting the existing size image and confirming exact dimensions; generate a no-text base and apply deterministic English dimensions locally.
If a model-generated scene contains readable English copy, hold it for human copy and claim review instead of automatically rejecting it.

profiles.description: Flat decorative stickers intended for helmets, motorcycles, or other approved product surfaces.
planning_rules: Preserve the exact flat sticker artwork, cut edges, colors, proportions, and intended surface application from the approved source identity image.

By default, do not generate white-background hero, size-card, or macro-detail images for stickers. The human operator may explicitly add a size card only after confirming exact dimensions; generate a no-text base and apply deterministic English dimensions locally.
Use believable application scenes only. Do not show peeling, adhesive layers, removability, waterproofing, durability, or safety performance unless separately source-supported and human-approved.
If a model-generated selling-point scene contains readable English copy, retain it for human copy and claim review instead of automatically rejecting it.

profiles.description: Fallback profile for products without a category-specific rule.
planning_rules: Choose image types from visible product evidence and actual use, not generic marketing assumptions.
Use a white hero, at least one believable use scene, one feature view, one macro detail, and a size card only when dimensions are verified.
